Method

  • Current EuroCup sample: Round 1 only.
  • MIN/G and PIR/min use official EuroCup current-season minutes only.
  • Projected PIR regresses Round 1 output toward a price baseline, then applies a small matchup/risk factor.
  • DvP uses real basketball points by position, validated against box-score points allowed.
